faq.signIn.freeA: Yes. hired.video is free to start with AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan ($9.95/mo) unlocks unlimited features.
faq.signIn.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-in via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, email/password, and passwordless magic links. All methods are free.
faq.signIn.methodsQ: What sign-in methods does hired.video support?
faq.signIn.resetA: Click 'Forgot your password?' on the login page, enter your email, and you'll receive a reset link. You can also use passwordless magic link sign-in as an alternative.
faq.signIn.resetQ: How do I reset my password?
faq.signUp.freeA: Yes. hired.video is completely free to start. You get AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching (5/month), 50K AI tokens/month, and access to all 10+ career tools. No credit card required.
faq.signUp.freeQ: Is hired.video free to sign up?
faq.signUp.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-up via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, or email/password. All methods are free and give you immediate access to the platform.
faq.signUp.planA: The free plan includes: 1 published AI video resume, ATS-friendly resume builder, Chrome extension for job tracking, AI tools (resume scorer, optimizer, salary calculator, and more), career dashboard, job matching, and unlimited networking. Pro ($9.95/mo) adds unlimited videos, voice cloning, 1080p export, and 1M AI tokens/month.
faq.signUp.planQ: What's included in the free plan?
faq.signUp.setupA: Under 2 minutes. Sign up with Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, or email, choose your role (Job Seeker, Recruiter, or Employer), and you're in. You can create your first AI video resume in 60 seconds.
faq.signUp.setupQ: How long does it take to set up?

messages.studioFaqSubheading: The quick answers to what creators ask before they generate their first AI video resume.
messages.studio.q1.q: Do I need to record myself on camera?
messages.studio.q1.a: No. Our AI generates a polished animated video from your written resume — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you'd rather record yourself, you can upload a selfie-style video and the Studio will cut it into your scenes.
messages.studio.q2.q: How long does it take to make a video resume?
messages.studio.q2.a: Most people finish their first video in about 60 seconds of wall-clock time. Paste your resume, pick a theme, and the AI handles the script, timing, and scene transitions. You can then edit anything you like before exporting.
messages.studio.q3.q: What does the AI actually generate?
messages.studio.q3.a: The AI writes a 4-scene script — hook, experience, achievements, and call-to-action — tailored to your role and target job. It also chooses typography, motion intensity, and scene timing. You can tweak any scene with plain-English instructions.
messages.studio.q4.q: Can I use my own branding?
messages.studio.q4.a: Yes. Save your colors, logo, and font once in a Brand Kit and every new video automatically applies your brand identity. Great for recruiters, creators, and companies producing multiple videos.
messages.studio.q5.q: Where can I publish my video?
messages.studio.q5.a: One click publishes directly to YouTube, or you can export MP4 and share manually. We also generate a public link with an embed snippet you can drop into LinkedIn, personal websites, or email signatures. Our AI LinkedIn post generator writes the hook, caption, and hashtags for you.
messages.studio.q6.a: Your first AI-generated video is free on every account. Paid plans unlock unlimited generations, premium themes, 1080p export without watermark, voice cloning, brand kits, and video analytics. See the pricing page for current tiers.
messages.studio.q7.q: What video formats and resolutions do you support?
messages.studio.q7.a: Export as MP4 in 720p or 1080p. Minimal, moderate, and cinematic motion presets. 16:9 landscape and 9:16 vertical (for TikTok, Reels, and LinkedIn short-form) are both supported.
messages.studio.q8.q: Can recruiters and companies use the Studio too?
messages.studio.q8.a: Yes — the Studio is designed for candidates, recruiters, and companies. Use it to create video resumes, video job ads, company promos, or recruiter personal-brand videos. Every use case uses the same AI engine with different templates.
